title: Turn off WooCommerce Analytics
description: Removes the Analytics section of WooCommerce Admin through WooCommerce's own woocommerce_admin_features filter. Analytics keeps its own lookup tables and fills them in from a scheduled job whenever an order changes, which is a continuous background cost on a busy store.
breaks: The Analytics reports are no longer in the admin menu
WooCommerce stops importing new orders into its analytics tables, so turning this back on leaves a gap until it catches up
